newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Cheektowaga, N.Y.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Cheektowaga, N.Y.

text.p: at Hawkins, Delafield & Wood, 67 Wall Street, New York, New
Bonds dated May 15, 1997, interest May 15 and November 15 each year commencing November 15, 1997. Bonds mature in principal installments on May 15 as follows:

The Town reserves the right to change the time and/or date of the bid opening, and notice thereof shall be provided at least 24 hours prior to the time set forth above and transmitted over the Munifacts wire.
Bids, accompanied by $100,900 good faith check, must be for all $5,045,000 bonds. Award shall be based on net interest cost.

Bidders must refer to the full Notice of Sale for the complete terms and conditions of the sale. Copies of said Notice and the Official Statement may be promptly obtained from Munistat Services, Inc., 12 Roosevelt Avenue, Port Jefferson Station, New York 11776, telephone number: (516) 331-8888; fax: (516) 331-8834, or 8555 Main Street, Suite #305, Williamsville, New York 14221, telephone number: (716) 632-2874.
